name: Critical Thinking
description: Logic validity, cognitive bias detection, assumption unbundling, and first-principles analysis.

dimensions.name: Fallacy & Bias Detection
dimensions.description: Spotting ad hominem, straw man, false dichotomy, sunk cost, and confirmation bias.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Instantly spots hidden fallacies in opponent's premise and exposes non-sequiturs.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Identifies primary logical flaw with minor delay or slight semantic confusion.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Fails to notice subtler biases; seduced by emotional rhetoric.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Employs logical fallacies in own arguments; easily misled.

dimensions.name: First-Principles Reasoning
dimensions.description: Boiling systems down to fundamental truths and reasoning up from there rather than by analogy.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Strips away conventional dogma; derives innovative conclusions from physics/axioms.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Deconstructs assumptions well but retains a few unexamined axioms.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Relies heavily on industry precedent ('This is how it has always been done').
rubricCriteria.0-49: Pure herd mentality; uncritically accepts surface assertions.
